Question: What are the company's reportable segments?

Answer: The company's reportable segments are: (i) Las Vegas Locals; (ii) Downtown Las Vegas; (iii) Midwest & South; and (iv) Online (collectively "Reportable Segments") [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 96; c1027]. The Online segment includes the operating results of Boyd Interactive and online market access fees from agreements with third parties throughout the United States [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 96; c1027]. This is consistent with the description in another section stating the same four reportable segments and that the Online segment includes the operating results of online gaming operations through market access agreements [boyd10k; Item 1; p. 4; c0027].
